recipes.name: Harissa Spiced Beans
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion, garlic, and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes, until softened.
Add the beans, tomatoes, and harissa, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes*. Deglaze the pan with a small splash of water if necessary.
Season with salt and pepper, and stir in the lemon juice.
Divide the coconut yogurt between your plates, top with the harissa beans, some avocado slices, and serve with toasted pita. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Also known as lima beans. † Harissa sauce is typically a thinner, milder form of harissa paste, blended with additional oil, tomatoes, or other liquids for a pourable consistency. It's available in both mild and hot varieties. * Harissa offers a deep tangy and spicy flavour, but add less if you'd prefer less heat.
Storage The beans can be stored separately from the other components in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
